# Large_Deviation_Study

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A mathematical approach to analyze rare events and tail probabilities in disordered systems, such as finite Kitaev chains. Enables understanding of extreme fluctuations in topological systems, critical for robust design of TCC architectures under disorder.
